title: Add a failing test that a temporary init installs a Cursor factory rule and a factory-run skill which name `idefactory pr open`, `idefactory pr comment`, and `idefactory pr capture` as the only legal pull-request steps, say the agent never merges, and say `sync-tasks`, `run`, `approve`, `complete`, `verify`, `ci scaffold`, and archive or spec sync run only after the human asks. The installed text does not name the Cursor pull-request tool or `gh pr create` as a legal step. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/pr-guidance.test.mjs` before the template edit. Then add that text to `templates/skills/factory-coordinator/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-run/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-openspec/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-governance/SKILL.md`, `templates/cursor/rules/factory.mdc`, `templates/cline/rules/factory.md`, and `templates/copilot/factory.agent.md`. Verify the same test passes.
acceptanceCriteria: Installed factory guidance allows only the three pull-request commands, never merges, and waits for the human before the named commands.
